data.narrative:
Gauss Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Milena Roveda that has raised €9M to date. The nuclear energy sector includes 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers such as Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, though no sufficiently dense peer cohort exists at the same stage and valuation tier to support a robust median-based approach.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here, using total raised (€9M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the next institutional stage. This yields an implied valuation of €18M. The Peer-Median method cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while 4 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 fall into the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier, making a sector-wide median potentially misleading rather than triangulating.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €15M (low) to €21M (high), with €18M as the median point. This range reflects moderate step-up expectations for a frontier nuclear technology platform at Series A. Key uncertainties include technology maturity and regulatory pathway clarity, neither of which can be assessed from capital structure alone. The single-method foundation also argues for caution; future rounds should enable peer-based cross-checks as the nuclear energy private market matures and similar-stage comparables accumulate.
